difficulty_note: TSDB loses acknowledged out-of-order samples when a WAL checkpoint drops a series record the WBL still references via the in-memory multiRef mapping made during WAL replay. Fix must track the WBL-referenced refs during WBL replay, keep them in WAL checkpoints, and release them once the WBL is truncated. Hidden test is the PR's end-to-end DB restart test (all sample types); one assertion calling the PR's new internal helper (isWBLPinnedSeriesRef) was removed from the hidden copy, and the PR's head_test.go cases (which call new internal helpers) were excluded.
